Stage-by-chromosome mutation browser

Each point is one unique donor-variant call on the canonical autosomes, positioned along concatenated chromosomes and grouped by developmental stage. Hover to inspect the exact mutation, donor, and the number of supporting cells. The red translucent span marks the top 1 kb hotspot window for that stage; the orange line marks the top 100 bp hotspot window.
